recognize_zh: 大型巨核細胞的多葉核旁邊，箭頭指處細胞質內有一顆完整的小型分葉核細胞，外圍有一圈透明空隙（clear halo），代表另一顆白血球完整地位於巨核細胞質內，即細胞穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a lobulated, hyperchromatic nucleus and abundant pale granular cytoplasm
Intact small cell with a lobulated nucleus within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm (arrow), consistent with a neutrophil
Clear halo/vacuole surrounding the engulfed cell, indicating it lies within a membrane-bound space
Engulfed cell retains nuclear integrity without degradation, distinguishing it from phagocytosis
Background of numerous red cells, a lymphocyte and an erythroid precursor
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. An intact small leukocyte with a lobulated nucleus, most likely a neutrophil, lies within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm surrounded by a clear halo (arrow), without evidence of degradation. Findings are consistent with emperipolesis of a neutrophil within a megakaryocyte, which can be seen in normal marrow and is increased in myeloproliferative neoplasms (particularly myelofibrosis) and reactive states.

ddx.vs: Phagocytosed cells lie within a histiocyte with a bland oval nucleus and show degeneration, whereas emperipolesis involves an intact cell inside a megakaryocyte.

ddx.dx: Overlapping cell on top of a megakaryocyte
ddx.vs: An overlying cell is in a different focal plane and lacks the surrounding clear halo within the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Separated nuclear lobe of the megakaryocyte
ddx.vs: A detached megakaryocyte lobe has the same dense chromatin as the parent nucleus and lacks its own cytoplasm and halo.
